headlines.description: Blaine Gabbert threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to MyCole Pruitt with 4:30 left and the Tennessee Titans kept their playoff hopes alive by rallying to beat the Washington Redskins 25-16 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gabbert keeps Titans' hopes alive, beating Redskins 25-16

events.name: Baltimore Ravens at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Lamar Jackson threw for 204 yards and had the longest touchdown pass of his brief career, and the Baltimore Ravens strengthened their chances of clinching a playoff spot with a 22-10 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson leads Ravens to 22-10 victory over Chargers

headlines.description: Baker Mayfield threw three touchdown passes to thrill a sellout, holiday-spirited crowd that came out to boo former Cleveland coach Hue Jackson. The Browns beat the Cincinnati Bengals 26-18 on Sunday and swept their southern Ohio neighbors for the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mayfield throws 3 TD passes as Browns down Bengals 26-18

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: The Dallas Cowboys wrapped up the NFC East title when Dak Prescott accounted for two touchdowns and Jaylon Smith returned a fumble 69 yards for a score in a 27-20 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott, Cowboys wrap up NFC East with 27-20 win over Bucs

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw a 44-yard Hail Mary to Kyle Rudolph as time expired in the first half to put the Minnesota Vikings ahead and they beat the Detroit Lions 27-9 Sunday, moving a step closer to playing in the postseason.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings beat Lions 27-9 to move step closer to playoffs

events.name: New York Giants at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Andrew Luck hooked up with Chester Rogers for a 1-yard TD pass with 55 seconds left Sunday to give the Colts their only lead of the game and a 28-27 win over the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck keeps Colts in playoff hunt with 28-27 win over Giants

headlines.description: Blake Bortles came off the bench late in the third quarter with the score tied and provided a spark Sunday, helping the Jacksonville Jaguars eliminate the Miami Dolphins from the AFC playoff race by winning 17-7.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blake Bortles rallies Jaguars past Dolphins 17-7

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: The New England Patriots earned their 10th straight AFC East title with Sony Michel running for 116 yards and a touchdown in a 24-12 victory over the Buffalo Bills 24-12 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats beat Bills 24-12, earn 10th straight AFC East title

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a 16-yard touchdown pass to Davante Adams with 6:23 left in overtime, leading the Green Bay Packers to a wild 44-38 victory over the New York Jets on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers leads Packers to wild 44-38 overtime win over Jets

headlines.description: Jake Elliott kicked a 35-yard field goal as time expired and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the Houston Texans 32-30 Sunday to keep their playoff hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles stay alive with 32-30 win over Texans

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw for 239 yards and three touchdowns, and the Atlanta Falcons handed Carolina Panthers their seventh straight loss and knocked their NFC South rivals out of playoff contention with a 24-10 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan, Falcons hand Panthers 7th straight loss, 24-10

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: C.J. Anderson, playing five days after he was signed by Los Angeles, rushed for 167 yards -- one shy of his career high -- and the Rams bounced back from a pair of losses to beat the troubled Arizona Cardinals 31-9 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Anderson runs for 167 yards, Rams beat Arizona 31-9

headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw one touchdown pass, Jordan Howard ran for another score and the Chicago Bears survived a fight and a late fumble to earn their eighth win in nine games, 14-9 over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears clinch No. 3 seed with 14-9 win over 49ers

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees capped a 326-yard passing performance with 2-yard touchdown to Michael Thomas with 1:25 left, and the New Orleans Saints clinched the top seed in the NFC playoffs with a 31-28 victory over Pittsburgh that dealt a significant blow to the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints narrowly upend Steelers and take top NFC seed

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a 2-yard pass to Ed Dickson with 7:31 left for his third touchdown strike, Chris Carson rushed for two scores, and the Seattle Seahawks clinched an NFC wild-card berth with a 38-31 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks clinch playoff berth outlasting Chiefs 38-31

headlines.description: Dwayne Harris returned a punt 99 yards for a touchdown after Denver failed to down it, and the Raiders gave their fans plenty to celebrate in their possible final game in Oakland, beating the Broncos 27-14 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders win possible final game in Oakland 27-14 vs. Broncos
